purpose: Separate deletion scope, selected output rows, and native-score interactions before choosing a DT propagation change.
selection_note: Fixed dispersed indices, chosen without sorting by performance. All original benchmark cases were previously inspected; this is exploratory diagnosis, not an untouched holdout.
scorer: Unmodified native eager compute_logprob_response_given_prompt; preserve BF16 reduction for the original RISE and save every token log-probability for target decomposition.
inputs: Preserve exact complete cached prompt and response plus EOS. No generation. All changed input positions must belong to the original eligible set.
query_definition: Original prompt final newline starting What, including its answer prefix; all other original eligible tokens form nonquery. Do not call this subset pure formatting.
new_DT_operators: None in stage A. Empty rule overrides, original content1 profile.
comparison_rule: Use fresh common model outputs for paired interventions; any sum over a changed target or different deletion endpoint is a distinct diagnostic, not a replacement for the original benchmark.
next_stage: Choose a small fixed set of mechanistically motivated uniform-rule variants after stage A. Freeze a candidate before constructing separate generalization examples. Keep original benchmark results.
